heading: How to Do It in BC
title:
1. Join [NP Circle](https://npcircle.ca/) for a national peer network.
2. If you work in longitudinal primary care, contact [NNPBC NP-PIP](https://www.nnpbc.com/practice-supports/np-pip/) about its community of practice and mentorship.
3. Register for an ECHO series that matches your caseload.

heading: How to Do It in Ontario
title:
1. Join [NPAO](https://npao.org/) for Ontario NP advocacy, events and its NP-led clinic directory, and [NP Circle](https://npcircle.ca/) for a national peer community.
2. Pick an [ECHO Ontario program](https://www.echoontario.ca/Join-an-ECHO/Programs) for case-based learning in your area of practice.
